geometry.higher_rank_subspace_caveat: When the true or effective edit rank is below the reported rank, extra basis vectors can be arbitrary. Read the singular values and captured energy alongside the subspace cosines.
geometry.heuristic_definition: Smallest k in 1..8 with captured full-delta energy >=0.95 and minimum even/odd subspace cosine >=0.95. Descriptive triage only; not a causal or deployment acceptance test.
geometry.interpretation: Low-rank edit recovery and symmetric projection compatibility are separate questions. Norm-preserving or oblique edits can remain low rank while failing U M U^T W fits. Neither semantic refusal causality nor transfer to REDCELL has been tested.

same_layer_down_comparison.interpretation: Frozen down subspace with attention-specific coefficients tests a restricted shared-subspace hypothesis. Unchanged down coefficients separately test the stronger shared-operator hypothesis. Neither is assumed or an inference result.
